usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing OpenID Connect realm in PDM — for example to rotate a client secret, change the issuer URL, or toggle autocreate after initial setup. Requires the `Realm.Allocate` privilege on the `/access/domains` ACL path; API tokens are allowed. Supply the `digest` field (obtained from the read endpoint) to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Update an Azure AD OIDC realm: rotate client key and enable autocreate

params.comment: Azure AD OIDC - updated client secret 2026-06-29

tips: Use the `delete` array to unset optional fields (e.g. `"delete": ["acr-values"]`) rather than sending an empty string.
Setting `default: true` on this realm will deselect any other realm currently marked as default on the PDM login page.
The `client-key` is write-only; it is not returned by the read endpoint, so keep your own record of the current secret before overwriting it.
Realm names are immutable after creation — to rename a realm you must delete and recreate it, which will break any existing user mappings.
